lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu₂Ga₂Au₈ (LuGaAu₄) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with 10 geometric neighbors (2 Au, 4 Ga, 4 Lu), Ga centers with 8 Au neighbors, and Lu centers with 16 Au neighbors, all within the body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Au 10-vertex polyhedra, corner-sharing between Au and Ga, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Au and Lu polyhedra.
